verdict_reason: This is a proxy-only composite with no source paper (task_metadata.py:48 records 'proxy-only', repository ''), so the reference is its own documented estimand -- cosine geometry over embedding rows -- and the ONE item codex held it at YELLOW for in round 5 is now closed. categories.py:338-339 reads `float('nan') if n_occ.std() == 0 else skew(n_occ)`, and I reproduced codex's exact trigger: six orthogonal rows with k = min(5, m-1) = 5 give the constant occurrence vector [5,5,5,5,5,5], and BLME now returns cat_hub_skew = nan, matching scipy.stats.skew([5]*6) = nan and the sibling geometry_hubness convention (previously 0.0, a fabricated 'perfectly symmetric'). Every analytic anchor is exact: three mutually orthogonal 10-token categories give intra 0.0, separation 1.0, purity 1.0 and purity_matched 1.0 for all three; six exactly-parallel relation differences give consistency 1.0 and analogy top-1/top-5 = 1.0/1.0. Scale exactness holds to the last bit -- over the contract ladder 1e-30, 1e-20, 1e-8, 1, 1e8, 1e19, 1e20 the maximum change in ANY separation or purity value is 0.000e+00 (all three separations stay exactly 1.000000000000, all three purities exactly 1.000000000000). The first-wins-by-JSON-order labelling is gone: reversing the order of all 14 categories in the asset changes 0 of the 148 numeric keys gpt2 emits, and the 14 ambiguous token ids are found and dropped identically on all seven models I ran. ADJUDICATION: codex's round-5 YELLOW was right about the convention and has been acted on; on this code state my round-5 GREEN and codex's objection agree.
comparable_reason: The number is tokenizer-dependent by construction and I measured the mechanism rather than only the correlation. Holding the ten labelled vectors and their geometry EXACTLY fixed and varying only the number of unlabelled candidate rows -- i.e. the vocabulary the k-NN search competes over -- purity falls 0.433333333 (V=20) -> 0.166666667 (V=40) -> 0.000000000 (V=120, 520, 5020), and purity_matched falls in lockstep to the same three values. The mapped populations also differ: over gpt2 / distilgpt2 / pythia-70m / pythia-160m / SmolLM2-135M / opt-125m / gpt2-medium the task maps 704 / 704 / 711 / 711 / 651 / 704 / 704 category token ids, with smallest scored category 13 / 13 / 14 / 14 / 10 / 13 / 13 tokens, so both the candidate set and the per-category ceiling move with the tokenizer. `cross_model_comparable` is emitted as a constant False but gates nothing.

github_reason: There is no released code to fetch. task_metadata.py:48 classifies geometry_categories as 'proxy-only' with an empty repository field, the 539-line module cites no paper, DOI or arXiv id, and the metrics (category separation, adaptive-k purity, category hubness skew, relation-difference consistency, analogy accuracy) are a BLME composite. Verification was therefore against independent analytic constructions: exact orthogonal clusters (separation 1.0, purity 1.0), exactly-parallel relation differences (consistency 1.0, analogy 1.0/1.0), and scipy.stats.skew as the arbiter for the hubness convention.
paper_reason: No source paper exists for this composite, so there is no published value to reproduce. The closed-form anchors that stand in for one are all exact: orthogonal-cluster separation = 1.0 and purity = 1.0 (both exactly, at every scale from 1e-30 to 1e20), constant-relation consistency = 1.0, analogy top-1 = top-5 = 1.0, and the degenerate hub-skew case = NaN in agreement with scipy.
confounds_reason: The confound is the tokenizer/vocabulary, and the causal test above settles it: with the labelled geometry held exactly fixed, growing the candidate population from 20 to 120 rows drives both purity and purity_matched from 0.433333333 to 0.000000000. Statistically, over a fresh 7-model local panel raw mean purity has Spearman -0.6699 with d_model (p = 0.0997) and matched mean purity -0.0197 (p = 0.9666) -- so the matched design does remove the width channel -- but the same panel's vocab_size spans only 49152-50304 (2.3%), so its rho = -0.9543 (p = 0.0008) for the matched mean is a tie-breaking artifact of a near-constant predictor and I do NOT rest the verdict on it. 0 of the 66 archived blme_verified_a runs contain geometry_categories, so no wide-vocabulary cross-model correlation is available; the intervention is the evidence.

CODE/GLOBAL STATE categories.py:184, 397, 481: three `np.random.seed(42)` calls reset NumPy's process-global legacy RNG, one of them inside the per-category loop of `_compute_relation_consistency`. This does not change THIS task's own (deterministic) values, but every later task in the same process inherits a reset stream. The matched-purity subsample in the same file already uses `np.random.default_rng`; these should too.

PROTOCOL categories.py:396-406: analogy quartets are enumerated exhaustively below n = 20 pairs and sampled 200 times WITH REPLACEMENT at or above it, a discontinuity exactly at the boundary (n = 19 gives 342 distinct ordered pairs, n = 20 gives 200 draws with duplicates).
